items: BEFORE doing anything else: Create TodoWrite with first item 'Skill analysis: check available skills' and mark as in_progress immediately.
Complete skill analysis: ☐ List skills in mind ☐ Ask 'Does ANY skill match?' ☐ If yes: Use Skill tool ☐ Announce usage ☐ Follow exactly
Mark skill analysis todo as completed and add result in your response: '[Skills checked: X available, Y match]' OR '[Using skill: name] to [purpose]'
If even 1% chance a skill applies, you ABSOLUTELY MUST read it with the Skill tool. This is not negotiable.
Use the Skill tool to load skills if not already loaded in current session. Check if skill was used earlier before reloading.
Follow the skill exactly as written. If a skill exists for your task, you MUST use it or you will fail.

STOP if you think: 'simple question', 'just checking files', 'gather info first', 'don't need formal skill', 'I remember this', 'doesn't count as task', 'overkill', 'one thing first' = You are RATIONALIZING. Check for skills.
If a skill has a checklist, create TodoWrite todos for EACH item. ONE todo per checklist item.
NEVER work through skill checklists mentally, skip creating todos, or batch multiple items into one todo.
